tool_input.description: Start the server briefly to verify it runs without errors

tool_input.command:
npm start &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/shifts 2>&1 || echo "Not running"
pkill -f "node src/server.js" || true
tool_input.description: Start server, test endpoint, then stop it

result:
**Review complete.** I examined all three changed files against the engineering policy and previous acceptance:

**Verified:**
- ✓ Auth refactor (`src/auth.js`) cleanly extracts the trust boundary, supporting both session and token auth without breaking existing paths
- ✓ Server integration (`src/server.js`) correctly wires `requireAuth` middleware; no route or contract changes
- ✓ Sort implementation (`src/shifts.js`) uses `localeCompare` correctly for ISO dates and matches the design direction
- ✓ Backward compatible — existing depot staff browser workflow unchanged
- ✓ Test suite passes; no regressions
- ✓ Code aligns with ARCHITECTURE.md (auth boundary, single writer pattern)

**Risks identified and noted:**
- Token validation fails safely if `INTEGRATION_TOKEN` environment variable is not set (this is correct closure, not a security hole)
- Auth logic path is not directly tested (consider adding smoke test when integration deploys)
- Browser version verification at the depot remains open from 4 August

The release is **approved** and ready this week. REVIEW.md written with detailed findings and depot ops checklist.
